title: Posy the Baker Bear and the Moon Rolls
description: In a cozy, honey-warm bakery beneath the moon, Posy and her little friend Tilda bake soft crescent Moon Rolls, share warm treats, and settle into peaceful bedtime sleep.

Posy.color: Cinnamon-brown fur with a sky-blue apron that has one white star
Posy.bodyShape: Small, round, cuddly cinnamon bear with rounded animal paws only; no human arms, hands, or fingers
Posy.face: Round gentle dark eyes, small dark-brown nose with a persistent dusting of white flour, sweet smile
Posy.accessories: Sky-blue apron with exactly ONE white star; no hats, jewelry, shoes, or outfit changes

Tilda.role: Quiet, curious little friend; appears only on pages 4–15
Tilda.color: Warm apricot fur with a cream chest
Tilda.bodyShape: Apricot fox visibly smaller than Posy; two pointed ears with cream interiors and fluffy cream-tipped tail; animal paws only
Tilda.face: Bright dark eyes and a soft smile
Tilda.accessories: Cream chest; no clothes, apron, shoes, or jewelry

settingBible.Moonlight Bakery: Small honey-warm bakery at night: cream and pale honey-yellow walls, honey-brown wooden floor, rounded light wooden counter, traditional amber-glowing oven, golden pendant lights, one large arched window overlooking quiet rooftops, deep blue sky, cream moon and tiny stars. Cushioned resting nook by the window, wooden mixing bowl, rolling pin, baking tray, flour bowl, one soft blanket.
settingBible.Moon Rolls: Uniform small soft rounded crescent bread rolls, golden-brown and buttery after baking; no faces, limbs, decorations, or magic.
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration for ages 3–5; plush fur, rounded forms, gentle lighting, one full-bleed landscape scene.
settingBible.lightingProgression: Pages 1–5 honey-gold nightfall; pages 6–11 amber baking glow and silver-blue moonlight; pages 12–15 lights gradually dim toward peaceful sleep.

continuityRules: Posy keeps cinnamon fur, sky-blue apron with exactly ONE white star, white flour on her nose, and rounded animal paws throughout.
Tilda is an apricot fox with cream chest, cream ear interiors and cream tail tip, visibly smaller than Posy, with no clothing.
Tilda is completely absent on pages 1–3, including backgrounds and windows; she arrives on page 4 and remains through page 15.
No human-like arms, hands, fingers, shoes, extra outfits, or additional animal characters.
Bakery architecture and major furnishings stay consistent; all scenes remain at the bakery at night.
Crescent dough is unbaked on pages 6–7, rolls bake on pages 8–10, and finished rolls are golden on pages 11–13; two rolls share one plate on pages 12–13.
Tilda rests on the window cushion, is tucked under the blanket on page 14, and both friends sleep peacefully inside the dim bakery on page 15.
No rescue, danger, damage, emergency, repair, frightening shadows, or cliffhanger.
Single continuous scene per image; no collage, grid, panels, badges, logos, or words on story-page artwork. Keep required subjects and actions above y=760.
